answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 25854 Country: India Title: I HAVE SMALL FAMILY 2 SON (9,4) AND WIFE.FROM LAST ONE YEAR I HAVE ONE LAKH RS AND MY WIFE SPEND 4.6(4 TOLE 6 GRAM) GOLD.I DOING A JOB IN A USED 2/4 WHEELER COMPANY.I USING SAID ONE LAKH RS IN PERSONAL BUSINESS.WHAT ZAKATH IS COMPULSORY ON ME. PLEASE ASSIST ME.. Question: AUS SALAMU ALAIKUM I HAVE SMALL FAMILY 2 SON (9,4) AND WIFE.FROM LAST ONE YEAR I HAVE ONE LAKH RS AND MY WIFE SPEND 4.6(4 TOLE 6 GRAM) GOLD.I DOING A JOB IN A USED 2/4 WHEELER COMPANY.I USING SAID ONE LAKH RS IN PERSONAL BUSINESS.WHAT ZAKATH IS COMPULSORY ON ME. PLEASE ASSIST ME......AUS SALAMU ALAIKUM. Answer ID: 25854 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2313/H=716/th=1431) What do you mean by "your wife spends 4.6 gram gold?? Zakah shall be wajib on the amount of one lakh rupees invested by you in the business as well as on its profit. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
